rationale: After reaching a maximum favorable excursion of 1.83% at the $54.30 session low, price has round-tripped nearly the entire move and reclaimed the 5-minute 9-EMA ($55.00) with a series of higher 1-minute lows. Notably, this bounce occurred even as the broader market weakened further (SPY falling from -2.93% at entry to -3.80%), signaling seller exhaustion and relative strength that invalidates the short breakdown thesis.
